ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias <> "sconn",
LEN(BillingPostalCode) > 10,
OR( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", $RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Salem/MIA" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Postal Code can only be up to 10 characters.
